comment.author: uid:1000
comment.body: Your attempts are being OOM-killed, not failing on logic. Every tally job runs in a cgroup capped at 8 GiB (the daemon runs with --memory-max-bytes 8589934592), and the kernel killed rustc inside your job service 14 times in the last five hours (constraint=CONSTRAINT_MEMCG, task=rustc). The apply_patch and exec_command faults that followed were your process tree dying mid-edit, not a patching problem. Observed constraint: the workspace build and test must fit inside 8 GiB of resident memory. Required outcome is unchanged - attempt counting becomes a derivation over epochs, resume and the pardon concept delete, and the workspace stays green. Constrain build parallelism so compilation fits the cap; the machine diagnosis for the same fault on another lane proposed CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2. Do not reduce test coverage, skip the workspace test, or narrow the change to fit inside the cap.
